characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.description: Consulting detective investigating the murder at Birlstone.

characters.name: Inspector MacDonald
characters.description: Police inspector conducting interviews and leading the investigation into Mr. Douglas's death.

characters.name: White Mason
characters.description: An officer involved in the investigation at Birlstone who suggests interviewing household witnesses in the dining room.

characters.name: Ames
characters.description: Butler at Birlstone Manor who has served Mr. Douglas for five years.

characters.name: Mr. Douglas
characters.description: Also known as Jack Douglas; a rich gentleman who made his fortune in mining in California and was murdered at his residence, Birlstone Manor.

characters.name: Mrs. Douglas
characters.description: Wife of Mr. Douglas; a tall, beautiful, and self-possessed woman of thirty.

characters.name: Cecil Barker
characters.description: Former mining partner and devoted friend of Mr. Douglas from California who was staying at Birlstone.

characters.name: Mrs. Allen
characters.description: Housekeeper at Birlstone Manor who is somewhat hard of hearing.

characters.name: Bodymaster McGinty
characters.description: An individual associated with the Valley of Fear whose name Mr. Douglas uttered with anger and horror while delirious.

locations.name: Birlstone
locations.description: Ancient manor house surrounded by a shallow moat with a drawbridge, where Mr. Douglas lived and was killed.

locations.name: Tunbridge Wells
locations.description: Town where Mr. Douglas went shopping the day before the crime.

locations.name: Benito Canyon
locations.description: Location in California where Mr. Douglas and Cecil Barker were successful mining partners.

locations.name: London
locations.description: City where Cecil Barker came to live and where Mr. Douglas met and became engaged to his second wife.

locations.name: Valley of Fear
locations.description: Valley where Mr. Douglas had previously lived and experienced a terrible ordeal, connected to Bodymaster McGinty.

relationships.subject: Cecil Barker
relationships.explanation: Cecil Barker and Mr. Douglas were mining partners in California and remained close friends.

relationships.subject: Mr. Douglas
relationships.explanation: Mr. Douglas and Mrs. Douglas had been married for five years before his death.

relationships.subject: Ames
relationships.explanation: Ames worked as butler for Mr. Douglas for five years.

relationships.subject: Mrs. Allen
relationships.explanation: Mrs. Allen worked as housekeeper at Mr. Douglas's home.

relationships.subject: Cecil Barker
relationships.explanation: Barker served as best man at Mr. Douglas's marriage to his second wife.

relationships.subject: Mr. Douglas
relationships.explanation: During a feverish delirium, Mr. Douglas repeatedly spoke Bodymaster McGinty's name with anger and horror.
